info.title: Fiona commerce events
info.description: Commerce owns InquiryPersisted v2. An HTTP 201 commits the inquiry, initial Estimate, associations, authorship and event atomically; JetStream acceptance happens asynchronously. At-least-once publication requires durable consumer deduplication by event id. Late duplicates may follow later aggregate sequences. Contact name and email are personal data: restrict account access and consumers, enforce stream retention, and establish a separate PostgreSQL retention policy (runtime does not purge outbox rows).

inquiryPersistedV2.description: Existing FIONAS_EVENTS stream, subjects fionas.events.>. Operator-provisioned file storage, limits retention, default max age 30 days and duplicate window 24 hours; verify actual deployment values independently. Commerce never administers this stream.

publishInquiryPersisted.description: Publishes the immutable persisted UTF-8 payload with stable UUID Nats-Msg-Id, expecting FIONAS_EVENTS. Only a PubAck naming FIONAS_EVENTS with positive sequence confirms delivery; duplicate PubAck is accepted. Runtime retries all failures. JetStream duplicate windows do not provide permanent deduplication. Consumers must persist processed ids and use aggregate sequence metadata where ordering matters.

InquiryPersistedV2.name: InquiryPersistedV2
InquiryPersistedV2.title: Commerce committed a new inquiry and its initial Estimate

correlationId.description: Exact original Idempotency-Key; opaque case-sensitive text, not necessarily a UUID. Distinct from event identity.

Nats-Msg-Id.description: Equals payload id and runtime outbox UUID, unchanged on every retry.

Fionas-Aggregate-Sequence.description: Runtime business sequence for (producer, inquiry, inquiryId), normally 1 for creation; distinct from the broker stream sequence.

occurredAt.description: Authoritative persisted inquiry.createdAt in UTC, PostgreSQL microsecond precision; never publication time.

name.description: Canonical stored customer name, including when a returning customer's submitted name differs. Personal data.

email.description: Canonical trimmed lowercase recipient address. Shallow business validation, no email format guarantee. Personal data.
